lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a quasi-rectilinear grid. Posterior to the gill slits, spots form primary horizontal rows aligned with the longitudinal axis, with spacing between centroids approximately 1.5 to 2 times the spot diameter.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a grid where spots are positioned at the nodes of the vertical and horizontal axes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple longitudinal ridges are present on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient (high intensity on the dorsal edge, lower intensity/shadow on the ventral edge) running parallel to the body axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated in the anterior and medial regions of the fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The post-cranial and gill region exhibits a distinct transition from fine, high-density micro-speckling to the larger, regularly spaced blobs characteristic of the lateral flank.
